messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 15 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The firm's DMS (FileSite) will be unavailable this Saturday 15 February from 08:00 to 13:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before Friday close. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
